steps.title: Start the garlic
steps.body: Heat **2 Tbsp canola oil** and **3 garlic cloves, crushed** in a Dutch oven over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant.

steps.title: Add the stock
steps.body: Stir in **1 cup unsalted chicken stock**.

steps.title: Make the roux
steps.body: In a bowl, whisk together **1¼ chicken stock**, **½ cup 2% milk** and **8 Tbsp flour**. Add to the garlic mixture and stir until thick.

steps.title: Finish the sauce
steps.body: Remove from heat and add, stirring until smooth: **4 ounces low fat cream cheese**, **½ tsp salt** and **¼ tsp black pepper**.

steps.title: Add the pasta
steps.body: Add the cooked pasta, tossing to coat. Let stand 5 minutes.

steps.title: Pour and top
steps.body: Pour into a baking dish and sprinkle the top with **¾ cup shredded cheddar cheese**.

steps.title: Broil
steps.body: Broil for 3 minutes under the oven broiler until the cheese melts.
